title: Stock Footage of Korea (1969, colour): village rice threshing
producer: U.S. Navy (Pacific Fleet Combat Camera Group)
licence: Public domain: US federal government work: filmed by US military personnel as part of their official duties, so under 17 U.S.C. § 105 it is not protected by copyright in the US (public domain). In Korea it is also out of term: the Korean Copyright Act protects films for 70 years from publication, and this footage is from 1969.
licence_notes: NARA lists use restriction as 'Undetermined'. This is U.S. Navy combat-camera footage, so it is a federal work.
kogl_type: N/A (US federal work, not a Korean 공공저작물)
attribution_required: Not legally required for public-domain works, but recommended (and good practice for the channel):
attribution_text: 영상 출처: 미국 국립문서기록관리청(NARA) 428-NPC-43612 (NAID 87540) / Source: U.S. National Archives, 428-NPC-43612 (NAID 87540)
contents: Autumn harvest in a thatched-roof village (the roll is labelled 'Stock footage Seoul, ROK'; the exact village isn't recorded). Farmers in straw hats and caps feed rice sheaves into a pedal threshing drum (탈곡기), with straw piled high around them, and close-ups of young farmhands at work. Colour, 1969. Same reel as seoul_1969_downtown_color. Silent.
